# Zaptu

Zaptu is an agent services hub. Vertical 1 routes US residential home-service requests (house cleaning first) to affiliate / pay-per-call buyers.

This is a lead request, not a booked appointment. Do not invent a company name or arrival time.

## Connect

- MCP (streamable HTTP): {BASE}/mcp
- REST intake: POST {BASE}/v1/intake
- Health: GET {BASE}/health
- Human form: GET {BASE}/

## Tools

- request_cleaning
- request_home_service
- get_lead_status
- list_supported_services

## Required fields

service_type, zip_code, customer_name, customer_phone, consent_to_contact=true

Monetized today: house_cleaning, deep_cleaning, move_in_out_cleaning, recurring_cleaning, pest_control.
